=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:185-196 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gate’s `@tsv` output is parsed with `cut -f1/-f2/-f3`, so a tab in the commit subject can misalign the extracted login fields.
  WHY: All reviewers flagged the same brittle TSV parsing root cause; this can produce wrong author/committer identity matches and therefore incorrect skip decisions.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:179-183 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The self-triggered skip gate checks `EVENT_NAME == "pull_request"` even though the reusable workflow runs under `workflow_call`, so the skip path may never activate.
  WHY: The reported root cause is that `github.event_name` inside the called workflow is `workflow_call`, making the `pull_request` condition unreachable and the feature ineffective.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:88-92 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `PR_HEAD_SHA` is set directly from `github.event.pull_request.head.sha` without a fallback for non-PR contexts.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this can leave the variable empty on `workflow_dispatch`/other non-PR paths, though downstream checks make it fail open.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:205,207 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic log lines print `PR_NUMBER` and `PR_HEAD_SHA` without default placeholders.
  WHY: This only affects log readability when the variables are empty; reviewers treated it as a minor observability issue.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:179,3861-3865 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The post-commit retrigger guard exits early for normal `[ai-autofix]` commits, and the subsequent synchronize run is also skipped, so the autofix loop can stop after the first commit.
  WHY: The reviewer reported that both retrigger paths are removed, preventing follow-up verification passes and leaving only the slower orchestrator stall recovery.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:194-196 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The gate uses `cut -f1/-f2/-f3` on `@tsv` output, which can mis-parse identity fields if the commit message contains tab characters.
  WHY: A tab in the commit message can shift the field boundaries and cause the wrong author/committer login values to be extracted, leading to incorrect skip decisions.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:92 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `PR_HEAD_SHA` is assigned only from `github.event.pull_request.head.sha` and has no fallback for non-`pull_request` events.
  WHY: On `workflow_dispatch` or similar contexts, the value can be empty; the downstream guard makes this safe, but the pattern is inconsistent with `PR_NUMBER`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:180-182 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `EVENT_NAME == "pull_request"` check may not match when the workflow is invoked through `workflow_call`.
  WHY: If the reusable workflow does not inherit a `pull_request` event name, the self-triggered autofix skip logic will never activate.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:205,207 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The log lines print `PR_NUMBER` and `PR_HEAD_SHA` without default values.
  WHY: Empty variables make the logs less informative, but this does not break runtime behavior.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:186 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `@tsv` plus `cut` parsing of commit metadata is brittle when the commit subject contains tab characters.
  WHY: A tab in the commit subject can shift the extracted field indices for `head_author_login` and `head_committer_login`, which can make the identity guard misidentify the commit author.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:92 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}` lacks a fallback when `github.event.pull_request` is absent.
  WHY: This can leave `PR_HEAD_SHA` empty in non-PR contexts such as `workflow_dispatch` or `push`, which is inconsistent with other inputs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:205, 207 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic log lines do not provide default placeholders for potentially empty values.
  WHY: This only reduces observability when the variables are empty and does not affect correctness.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
